    In the 2026 MLB season opener on March 25, the New York Yankees defeated the San Francisco Giants 7-0.
    Max Fried dominated with 6.1 scoreless innings and four strikeouts, while Aaron Judge struggled, recording a "golden sombrero" (four strikeouts). Logan Webb allowed six earned runs in 5 innings. 
    New York Yankees vs. San Francisco Giants (March 25, 2026) 
    • Final Score: Yankees 7, Giants 0
    • Winning Pitcher: Max Fried (NYY) - 6.1 IP, 0 ER, 2 H, 4 K, 1 BB
    • Losing Pitcher: Logan Webb (SF) - 5.0 IP, 6 ER, 7 K 
    Key Player Stats (Yankees):
     
    • Max Fried: 6.1 IP, 0 R, 2 H, 4 K
    • Aaron Judge: 0-for-4, 4 K (Golden Sombrero)
    • Taylor Grisham: 3B, 2 RBI
    • J. Caballero: 2B, 1 RBI
    • R. McMahon: 2 RBI 
    Key Player Stats (Giants): 
    • Logan Webb: 5.0 IP, 6 ER, 7 K
    • Heliot Ramos: Started in LF 
    Key Game Notes: 
    • The game was played at Oracle Park and streamed exclusively on Netflix.
    • The Yankees took an early 7-0 lead, with Max Fried retiring 15 of the final 16 batters he faced.
    • Giants manager Tony Vitello made his debut.
